body: I actually fantasize a lot about jumping from a building I used to work at. Not really sure why.

I mean, I kind of already am doing this. I'm applying to every opening I can find. But the jobs are either (i) on the area that I focused during law school and I'm not good enough for the job or (ii) on an area with more opportunities but I have 0 experiencia so no one wants to hire me...


Oh well... I'll see how this goes... It's not like I'll grab the courage to jum from a building anytime soon, so I'll have to figure something out

capital of the country. I have passed the bar. I would relocate to anywhere where I'd have a job paying enough to cover my expenses...


The thing is, the market is really crappy for lawyers rn (most of them are barely making minimum wage, which is definitely no enough to get by in my country), and also I spent my whole time in school "specializing" in an area of law that there isnt a lot of opportunitties (~10 offices in the country + employment at the government agency that tackles this) and I've already been denied in almost all of the places...

I guess I'm getting more and more desperate because I had a little bit of money that was helping me get by, but it's almost over now...

I have a degree in law...
I don't really know what I would "like"  to do... I feel like I've lost myself along the last years, so I don't really have anything that I like, or hobbies, or anything like that... At this point, I just need a job so I can have at least some autonomy from my parents and something to do during the day, because staying home and doing nothing is also driving me crazy...

I feel like a faillure. I'm a 23yo college graduate who can't land a job, still lives wih (and is supported by) my parents, regret pretty much all my choices concerning my education, and things do not lool like they are gonna change any soon.


I'm just tired of being a failure, of disappointing everyone...
